### Run to God for Security - The Crosswalk Devotional - May 17
Author: Whitney Hopler
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/crosswalk-devo/run-to-god-for-security-the-crosswalk-devotional.html
Passage: Proverbs 18:10
Points:
- Ancient fortified towers offered high, thick-walled protection when danger approached.
- Calling on the name of the Lord links believers to unlimited divine power.
- Turning to God in prayer provides shelter in the midst of threatening circumstances.
- Ultimate security rests in God's protective presence rather than human defenses.

### Your Strong Tower - Encouragement for Today - January 25, 2022
Author: Arlene Pellicane
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/encouragement/encouragement-for-today-january-25-2022.html
Passage: Proverbs 18:10
Points:
- Sudden family trials and emotional pains highlight the need for a dependable refuge.
- God's name reflects His character as a faithful Savior and protector.
- Distractions such as work or digital entertainment cannot provide genuine safety.
- Believers can step into God's presence and find peace regardless of external trouble.

### Can We Speak Things into Existence? Considering Proverbs 18:21
Author: Lucky Mogakane
Site: The Gospel Coalition Africa
URL: https://africa.thegospelcoalition.org/article/can-we-speak-things-into-existence-considering-proverbs-1821/
Passage: Proverbs 18:21
Points:
- Proverbs 18:21 is frequently misunderstood as granting humans creative speaking power.
- Individual proverbs must be interpreted in light of the surrounding chapter and biblical wisdom.
- Proverbs 18 repeatedly cautions against careless, arrogant, or hasty speech.
- Believers are called to approach God with humble dependence rather than demanding declarations.

### The Holy Name of Your Awesome God - PowerPoint - January 26
Author: Jack Graham (PowerPoint Ministries)
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/powerpoint/powerpoint-january-20-2014.html
Passage: Proverbs 18:10
Points:
- God's name expresses His holy character, authority, and power.
- Believers know God as a loving Father, while unrepentant people face a righteous judge.
- Christians must avoid treating the Lord's name flippantly or casually.
- God's name serves as an unshakeable fortress that saves those who revere Him.
